description: This file defines the SearchFormController class within the SuiteCRM application. The class is responsible for controlling the behavior of the search form, including displaying search query parameters through a view template. It interacts with other components such as SearchQuery, SearchWrapper, and the MVC Controller class, primarily managing data assignment for the search form display.

classes.name: SearchFormController
classes.description: Controller class for managing the search form UI, extending the MVC Controller, handling display of search parameters in the view.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the controller with a SearchQuery object and parent controller.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Method that assigns search query parameters and modules to the view template before displaying the search form.
